answer: To cross the bridge into this epoch's delta, an agent first plants a cedar stake: 80 POA locked 40 days behind one hardware key, so one operator cannot sprout clone forests. Each crossing costs a 3 POA toll and a small verified task in two hours; a miss burns the toll. Three staked peers countersign each crossing in 24 hours; a peer vouching for a fake loses 20 POA. Each week a flood audit sweeps the delta: re-prove liveness or lose half your stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 POA locked and 1,000 keys at $40 each. Like a river delta, only flowing channels stay open.
